decToBool : ∀ {A : Set} → Dec A → Bool

decTo⊎ : ∀ {A : Set} {x y : A} → Dec (x ≡ y) → (x ≡ y) ⊎ ¬ (x ≡ y)
decTo⊎ (yes p) = inj₁ p
decTo⊎ (no np) = inj₂ np

shape-size : List ℕ → ℕ
shape-size [] = 1
shape-size (d ∷ ds) = d * shape-size ds

lemma-shape-size-positive : ∀ (shape : List ℕ) → (shape-size shape ≡ 0) ⊎ (1 ≤ shape-size shape)
lemma-shape-size-positive [] = inj₂ (s≤s z≤n)
lemma-shape-size-positive (zero ∷ ds) = inj₁ refl
lemma-shape-size-positive (suc d ∷ ds) with lemma-shape-size-positive ds
... | inj₁ sz0 = inj₁ (cong ((suc d) *_) sz0)
... | inj₂ one≤ =
  inj₂ (≤-trans one≤ (subst (λ m → shape-size ds ≤ m)
    (begin
      (suc d) * shape-size ds ≡⟨ refl ⟩
      (1 + d) * shape-size ds ≡⟨ *-distribʳ-+ 1 d (shape-size ds) ⟩
      (1 * shape-size ds) + (d * shape-size ds) ≡⟨ cong₂ _+_ (*-identityˡ (shape-size ds)) refl ⟩
      shape-size ds + (d * shape-size ds) ∎)
    (m≤m+n (shape-size ds) (d * shape-size ds))))

lemma-shape-size-product : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → shape-size (s1 ++ s2) ≡ shape-size s1 * shape-size s2
lemma-shape-size-product [] s2 = sym (*-identityˡ (shape-size s2))
lemma-shape-size-product (d ∷ ds) s2 = begin
  d * shape-size (ds ++ s2) ≡⟨ cong (d *_) (lemma-shape-size-product ds s2) ⟩
  d * (shape-size ds * shape-size s2) ≡⟨ sym (*-assoc d (shape-size ds) (shape-size s2)) ⟩
  (d * shape-size ds) * shape-size s2 ∎

lemma-shape-size-append-positive : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → 1 ≤ shape-size s2 → shape-size s1 ≤ shape-size s1 * shape-size s2
lemma-shape-size-append-positive s1 s2 one≤ with shape-size s2 | one≤
... | zero | ()
... | suc k | _ = m≤m+n (shape-size s1) (shape-size s1 * k)

lemma-shape-size-monotonic : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → 1 ≤ shape-size s2 → shape-size s1 ≤ shape-size (s1 ++ s2)
lemma-shape-size-monotonic s1 s2 one≤ =
  subst (λ m → shape-size s1 ≤ m) (lemma-shape-size-product s1 s2) (lemma-shape-size-append-positive s1 s2 one≤)

record Tensor (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) : Set where
  constructor mkTensor
  field
    data-vec : Vec ℚ (shape-size Shape)
    layout : Layout
    device : Device
    ownership : Ownership
    refcount : ℕ

open Tensor

shape-consistency : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  Data.Vec.length (data-vec t) ≡ shape-size Shape
shape-consistency t = refl

natToℚ : ℕ → ℚ
natToℚ zero = 0ℚ
natToℚ (suc n) = 1ℚ ℚ.+ natToℚ n

fromℕ : ℕ → ℚ
fromℕ = natToℚ

safeDiv : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
safeDiv x y with y ℚ.≟ 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no _ = x ℚ./ y

tensor-map : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (f : ℚ → ℚ) →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype
tensor-map f t = mkTensor (Data.Vec.map f (data-vec t)) (layout t) (device t) (ownership t) (refcount t)

tensor-zipWith : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype
tensor-zipWith f t1 t2 =
  mkTensor (Data.Vec.zipWith f (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)) (layout t1) (device t1) (ownership t1) (refcount t1)

tensor-add : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype
tensor-add = tensor-zipWith (ℚ._+_)

tensor-sub : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype
tensor-sub = tensor-zipWith (ℚ._-_)

tensor-mul : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype
tensor-mul = tensor-zipWith (ℚ._*_)

tensor-scalar-mul : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  ℚ →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype
tensor-scalar-mul s = tensor-map (λ x → s ℚ.* x)

tensor-sum : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  ℚ
tensor-sum t = Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (data-vec t)

tensor-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-zero Shape dtype = mkTensor (Data.Vec.replicate 0ℚ) ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED 1

tensor-one : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-one Shape dtype = mkTensor (Data.Vec.replicate 1ℚ) ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED 1

zipWith-replicate-left : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (x : ℚ) (ys : Vec ℚ n) →
  (∀ y → f x y ≡ y) →
  Data.Vec.zipWith f (Data.Vec.replicate x) ys ≡ ys
zipWith-replicate-left f x [] prf = refl
zipWith-replicate-left f x (y ∷ ys) prf = cong (λ z → z ∷ _) (prf y) ∷? where
  infixr 5 _∷?_
  _∷?_ : ∀ {n} {a b : ℚ} {as bs : Vec ℚ n} →
    a ≡ b → as ≡ bs → (a ∷ as) ≡ (b ∷ bs)
  _∷?_ refl refl = refl

foldr-replicate : ∀ (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z x : ℚ) (n : ℕ) →
  (∀ y → f z y ≡ y) →
  Data.Vec.foldr _ f z (Data.Vec.replicate x {n = n}) ≡ if decToBool (n ≟ 0) then z else Data.Vec.foldr _ f z (Data.Vec.replicate x {n = n})
foldr-replicate f z x zero prf = refl
foldr-replicate f z x (suc n) prf = refl

theorem-tensor-add-identity : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  tensor-add (tensor-zero Shape dtype) t ≡ t
theorem-tensor-add-identity t = cong (λ v → mkTensor v (layout t) (device t) (ownership t) (refcount t))
  (zipWith-replicate-left (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (data-vec t) (proj₁ (ℚP.+-identity)))

theorem-tensor-sum-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) →
  tensor-sum (tensor-zero Shape dtype) ≡ 0ℚ
theorem-tensor-sum-zero Shape dtype = foldr-replicate (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ 0ℚ (shape-size Shape) (proj₁ (ℚP.+-identity))

rational-exp-iter : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-exp-iter zero k acc term x = acc
rational-exp-iter (suc n) k acc term x =
  rational-exp-iter n (suc k) (acc ℚ.+ term) (safeDiv (term ℚ.* x) (natToℚ (suc k))) x

rational-exp : ℚ → ℚ
rational-exp x = rational-exp-iter 30 zero 0ℚ 1ℚ x

data Activation : Set where
  Relu : Activation
  Sigmoid : Activation
  Tanh : Activation
  Softmax : Activation
  Elu : ℚ → Activation
  LeakyRelu : ℚ → Activation

apply-activation : Activation → ℚ → ℚ
apply-activation Relu x = if decToBool (x ℚ.<? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x
apply-activation Sigmoid x = safeDiv 1ℚ (1ℚ ℚ.+ rational-exp (ℚ.- x))
apply-activation Tanh x = safeDiv (rational-exp x ℚ.- rational-exp (ℚ.- x)) (rational-exp x ℚ.+ rational-exp (ℚ.- x))
apply-activation Softmax x = rational-exp x
apply-activation (Elu α) x with (x ℚ.<? 0ℚ)
... | yes _ = α ℚ.* (rational-exp x ℚ.- 1ℚ)
... | no _ = x
apply-activation (LeakyRelu α) x with (x ℚ.<? 0ℚ)
... | yes _ = α ℚ.* x
... | no _ = x

tensor-apply-activation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Activation →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype
tensor-apply-activation act = tensor-map (apply-activation act)

tensor-softmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype
tensor-softmax t =
  let exps = tensor-map rational-exp t
      s = tensor-sum exps
  in mkTensor (Data.Vec.map (λ x → safeDiv x s) (data-vec exps)) (layout t) (device t) (ownership t) (refcount t)

absℚ : ℚ → ℚ
absℚ x with x ℚ.<? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = ℚ.- x
... | no _ = x

relu-nonneg-helper : (x : ℚ) → 0ℚ ℚ.≤ (if decToBool (x ℚ.<? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x)
relu-nonneg-helper x = ℚP.≤-refl

data NormType : Set where
  BatchNorm : NormType
  LayerNorm : NormType
  InstanceNorm : NormType
  GroupNorm : ℕ → NormType

tensor-normalize : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  NormType →
  ℚ →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype
tensor-normalize norm-type eps t =
  let size = shape-size sh
      xs = data-vec t
      total = Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ xs
      mean = safeDiv total (fromℕ size)
      centered = Data.Vec.map (λ x → x ℚ.- mean) xs
      variance = safeDiv (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (Data.Vec.map (λ x → x ℚ.* x) centered)) (fromℕ size)
      std = rational-exp (safeDiv (rational-log (variance ℚ.+ eps)) 2ℚ)
      normalized = Data.Vec.map (λ x → safeDiv x (std ℚ.+ eps)) centered
  in mkTensor normalized (layout t) (device t) (ownership t) (refcount t)

rational-log-iter : ℕ → ℚ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-log-iter zero y k acc term = acc
rational-log-iter (suc n) y k acc term =
  let k′ = suc k
      acc′ = acc ℚ.+ safeDiv term (fromℕ k′)
      term′ = ℚ.- (term ℚ.* y)
  in rational-log-iter n y k′ acc′ term′

rational-log : ℚ → ℚ
rational-log x = rational-log-iter 15 (x ℚ.- 1ℚ) zero 0ℚ (x ℚ.- 1ℚ)

data Loss : Set where
  MSE : Loss
  MAE : Loss
  CrossEntropy : Loss
  Hinge : Loss
  KLDivergence : Loss
  Huber : ℚ → Loss

compute-loss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Loss →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  ℚ
compute-loss MSE pred target =
  let diff = Data.Vec.zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      squared = Data.Vec.map (λ x → x ℚ.* x) diff
      sum-squared = Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared
  in safeDiv sum-squared (fromℕ (shape-size sh))
compute-loss MAE pred target =
  let diff = Data.Vec.zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      absd = Data.Vec.map absℚ diff
      sum-abs = Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ absd
  in safeDiv sum-abs (fromℕ (shape-size sh))
compute-loss CrossEntropy pred target =
  let log-pred = Data.Vec.map rational-log (data-vec pred)
      weighted = Data.Vec.zipWith (λ t p → t ℚ.* p) (data-vec target) log-pred
      ce-loss = ℚ.- (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ weighted)
  in safeDiv ce-loss (fromℕ (shape-size sh))
compute-loss Hinge pred target =
  let margin = Data.Vec.zipWith (λ t p → 1ℚ ℚ.- (t ℚ.* p)) (data-vec target) (data-vec pred)
      clamped = Data.Vec.map (λ x → if decToBool (x ℚ.<? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x) margin
      hinge-loss = safeDiv (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ clamped) (fromℕ (shape-size sh))
  in hinge-loss
compute-loss KLDivergence pred target =
  let kl-terms = Data.Vec.zipWith (λ t p → t ℚ.* rational-log (safeDiv t p)) (data-vec target) (data-vec pred)
      kl-loss = Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ kl-terms
  in safeDiv kl-loss (fromℕ (shape-size sh))
compute-loss (Huber δ) pred target =
  let diff = Data.Vec.zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      absd = Data.Vec.map absℚ diff
      hub = Data.Vec.map (λ a → if decToBool (a ℚ.<? δ) then ½ ℚ.* a ℚ.* a else δ ℚ.* (a ℚ.- ½ ℚ.* δ)) absd
      hub-loss = Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ hub
  in safeDiv hub-loss (fromℕ (shape-size sh))

data Regularization : Set where
  L1 : ℚ → Regularization
  L2 : ℚ → Regularization
  ElasticNet : ℚ → ℚ → Regularization

l1-regularization : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
l1-regularization λ t =
  λ ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (Data.Vec.map absℚ (data-vec t))

l2-regularization : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
l2-regularization λ t =
  λ ℚ.* Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (Data.Vec.map (λ x → x ℚ.* x) (data-vec t))

compute-regularization : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Regularization → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
compute-regularization (L1 λ) t = l1-regularization λ t
compute-regularization (L2 λ) t = l2-regularization λ t
compute-regularization (ElasticNet α β) t = l1-regularization α t ℚ.+ l2-regularization β t

data Scheduler : Set where
  ConstantLR : Scheduler
  StepLR : ℚ → ℕ → Scheduler
  ExponentialLR : ℚ → Scheduler
  CosineAnnealingLR : ℕ → Scheduler
  ReduceLROnPlateau : ℚ → ℕ → Scheduler
  WarmupLR : ℕ → Scheduler

rational-pi : ℚ
rational-pi = mkℚ 355 113

rational-cos-iter : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-cos-iter zero k acc term x = acc
rational-cos-iter (suc n) k acc term x =
  let denom = natToℚ ((suc (suc k)) * (suc (suc (suc k))))
      term′ = ℚ.- (safeDiv (term ℚ.* x ℚ.* x) denom)
  in rational-cos-iter n (suc (suc k)) (acc ℚ.+ term) term′ x

rational-cos : ℚ → ℚ
rational-cos x = rational-cos-iter 20 zero 0ℚ 1ℚ x

apply-scheduler : Scheduler → ℚ → ℕ → ℚ
apply-scheduler ConstantLR initial epoch = initial
apply-scheduler (StepLR γ step-size) initial epoch =
  initial ℚ.* rational-exp (rational-log γ ℚ.* fromℕ (epoch / step-size))
apply-scheduler (ExponentialLR γ) initial epoch =
  initial ℚ.* rational-exp (rational-log γ ℚ.* fromℕ epoch)

  let size = shape-size sh

      squared = Data.Vec.map (λ x → x ℚ.* x) diff
      sum-squared = Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared
  in safeDiv sum-squared (fromℕ (shape-size sh))

  let diff = Data.Vec.zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      absd = Data.Vec.map absℚ diff
      sum-abs = Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ absd
  in safeDiv sum-abs (fromℕ (shape-size sh))

      ce-loss = ℚ.- (Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ weighted)

      kl-loss = Data.Vec.foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ kl-terms
  in safeDiv kl-loss (fromℕ (shape-size sh))
compute-loss (Huber δ) pred target =
  let diff = Data.Vec.zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)
      absd = Data.Vec.map absℚ diff
      hub = Data.Vec.map (λ a → if decToBool (a ℚ.<? δ) then ½ ℚ.* a ℚ.* a else δ ℚ.* (a ℚ.- ½ ℚ.* δ)) absd

  let k = epoch / patience

  if decToBool (epoch ≤? warmup-epochs)

data Metric : Set where
  Accuracy : Metric
  Precision : Metric
  Recall : Metric

isPos : ℚ → Bool
isPos x = decToBool (x ℚ.<? ½) ∧ false ∨ not (decToBool (x ℚ.<? ½))

confusionCounts : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype →

confusionCounts pred target =
  let ps = Data.Vec.toList (data-vec pred)
      ts = Data.Vec.toList (data-vec target)
      pairs = Data.List.zip ps ts
      tp = Data.List.length (Data.List.filter (λ p → isPos (proj₁ p) ∧ isPos (proj₂ p)) pairs)
      tn = Data.List.length (Data.List.filter (λ p → not (isPos (proj₁ p)) ∧ not (isPos (proj₂ p))) pairs)
      fp = Data.List.length (Data.List.filter (λ p → isPos (proj₁ p) ∧ not (isPos (proj₂ p))) pairs)
      fn = Data.List.length (Data.List.filter (λ p → not (isPos (proj₁ p)) ∧ isPos (proj₂ p)) pairs)
  in tp , tn , fp , fn

  Metric →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Tensor sh dtype →

  let tp , tn , fp , fn = confusionCounts pred target

  in safeDiv (fromℕ correct) (fromℕ total)
compute-metric Precision pred target =

compute-metric Recall pred target =

  in safeDiv (fromℕ tp) (fromℕ (tp + fn))

  in safeDiv (2ℚ ℚ.* p ℚ.* r) (p ℚ.+ r)
compute-metric MSEMetric pred target = compute-loss MSE pred target

optimizer-step (SGD lr) clip w grad st =
  let g = Data.Vec.map (λ x → if decToBool (x ℚ.<? ℚ.- clip) then ℚ.- clip else if decToBool (clip ℚ.<? x) then clip else x) (data-vec grad)
      w′ = Data.Vec.zipWith (λ wi gi → wi ℚ.- (lr ℚ.* gi)) (data-vec w) g
  in mkTensor w′ (layout w) (device w) (ownership w) (refcount w) , st

  let g = Data.Vec.map (λ x → if decToBool (x ℚ.<? ℚ.- clip) then ℚ.- clip else if decToBool (clip ℚ.<? x) then clip else x) (data-vec grad)
      v′ = Data.Vec.zipWith (λ vi gi → (μ ℚ.* vi) ℚ.+ gi) (v st) g
      w′ = Data.Vec.zipWith (λ wi vi → wi ℚ.- (lr ℚ.* vi)) (data-vec w) v′
      st′ = mkOptState (m st) v′ (t st)
  in mkTensor w′ (layout w) (device w) (ownership w) (refcount w) , st′
optimizer-step (Adam lr β1 β2 eps) clip w grad st =
  let g = Data.Vec.map (λ x → if decToBool (x ℚ.<? ℚ.- clip) then ℚ.- clip else if decToBool (clip ℚ.<? x) then clip else x) (data-vec grad)
      t′ = suc (t st)
      new-m = Data.Vec.zipWith (λ mi gi → (β1 ℚ.* mi) ℚ.+ ((1ℚ ℚ.- β1) ℚ.* gi)) (m st) g
      new-v = Data.Vec.zipWith (λ vi gi → (β2 ℚ.* vi) ℚ.+ ((1ℚ ℚ.- β2) ℚ.* (gi ℚ.* gi))) (v st) g
      m-hat = Data.Vec.map (λ m_i → safeDiv m_i (1ℚ ℚ.- rational-exp (rational-log β1 ℚ.* fromℕ t′))) new-m
      v-hat = Data.Vec.map (λ v_i → safeDiv v_i (1ℚ ℚ.- rational-exp (rational-log β2 ℚ.* fromℕ t′))) new-v
      w′ = Data.Vec.zipWith (λ wi mi vi → wi ℚ.- safeDiv (lr ℚ.* mi) (rational-exp (safeDiv (rational-log (vi ℚ.+ eps)) 2ℚ) ℚ.+ eps)) (data-vec w) m-hat v-hat
      st′ = mkOptState new-m new-v t′
  in mkTensor w′ (layout w) (device w) (ownership w) (refcount w) , st′

### 1.1. A "Füstölgő Puskacső": Racionális Számok (ℚ) használata
A gépi tanulás (Deep Learning) ipari szabványa a lebegőpontos aritmetika (Floating Point: `float16`, `bfloat16`, `float32`). A GPU-k és TPU-k erre vannak optimalizálva.
*   **A kód megoldása:** `open import Data.Rational as ℚ`.
*   **Miért probléma ez?** A racionális számok (`p/q` alak) végtelen pontosságúak, de számításigényük exponenciálisan nőhet a műveletek során (a számláló és nevező hatalmasra hízik). Egy neurális hálózatban több millió szorzás és összeadás történik. Racionális számokkal egyetlen „forward pass” lefuttatása is lehetetlen lenne egy modern modellen.
*   **Verifikációs szempontból:** A lebegőpontos számok verifikációjának legnehezebb része a kerekítési hibák (rounding errors) és a numerikus stabilitás bizonyítása. A kód ezt a problémát teljesen megkerüli azzal, hogy racionális számokat használ, ahol nincs kerekítési hiba. ### 1.2. A "Kamu" Tételek (Buzzword Theorems)

Ez a tétel leplezi le leginkább, hogy a kód nem ment át valódi Agda fordítón, vagy a szerző nem érti, mit csinál.
*   **A kód:**
